question: What new kitchen gadget did I invest in before getting the Air Fryer?
gold_shape: temporal-comparison retrieval (Instant Pot vs Air Fryer)

baseline_attempt.answer: The available memory does not record any kitchen gadget you invested in before the Air Fryer.

diagnosis: Two-stage failure. (1) Stage D retrieval: the Instant Pot note (user-new-instant-pot-may-2023) ranked 26/50 (0.1889, matched only new/the) - the question's 'kitchen gadget ... invest ... before' has zero content-word overlap with 'Instant Pot pressure cooker soups stews'; the Air Fryer note ranked 1 (0.9550). Top-8 cutoff hid the gold note. recallQueryExpansion=true did NOT help (rank unchanged; its paraphrases still lacked the item name). (2) After fixing retrieval, stage G: model listed both dates (IP 'new' 05-21, AF 'acquired ~05-20' per 'got yesterday') and abstained 'cannot establish the order' - the premise-check instruction fired on unstated purchase dates. Root chronology: IP session 05-21 05:48 precedes AF session 05-21 22:54; LME gold reads the IP as the earlier investment.
fix: W1 write-time importInstructions clause: appliance/gadget/device/tool/equipment memories must include the generic category word in title and content (e.g. 'kitchen appliance: Instant Pot pressure cooker') so category-word queries find the item. H3d read-time answerInstruction clause: when a question's wording presupposes an ordering/fact and the notes contain exactly one candidate of the asked kind, name that candidate instead of rejecting the premise over unstated dates.

iterations.target: retrieval fixed (both notes top-2), answer still abstained on ordering
0.0 - length-stop empty answer + blank rescue answered WITHOUT notes (degraded)
0.0 - coherent but still abstains 'notes do not show it was acquired first'

iterations.hypothesis: W1 + H3d (premise-trust: exactly one candidate => accept presupposition)

banked_into: lmesseq-scratch/ov-banked.json (importInstructions W1 + answerInstruction H3d; pre-fix backup ov-banked-h2b.json)
caveats: H3b (long anti-abstention clause) triggered glm-5.3 length-stop empty answers twice; blank-rescue then answered WITHOUT the memory notes (listed unrelated topics). Instruction clauses must stay short. Blank-rescue dropping recall notes is a driver-level defect worth a ticket.
